Appearance:
 Shri Dhanajay Shukla - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Pramod Pandey - Govt. Advocate for the State.
ORDER Petitioner has filed this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India challenging order dated 29.5.2024 contained in Annexure P/6.

By the said order, Additional District Judge, Devsar District Satna has dismissed the application filed by the petitioner under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act of 2013.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Devsar District Satna
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act of 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Application was dismissed on the grounds that applicant ought to have filed an application before the Collector and Collector shall refer the matter before Authority for deciding the claims.
2. Counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that he had preferred an application for reference before Collector.
Collector has not referred the matter and application was pending for more than 30 days.
In said condition, Authority could have asked Collector to send reference within a period of 30 days.

Authority has committed an error of law in not NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:577 2 WP-24037-2024 acting in accordance with provision of Section 64 of the Act of 2013.

3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. No purpose will be served in issuing notices to the respondents.
Authority has acted contrary to provision of Section 64 of the Act of 2013.

Petitioner has mentioned in his application that his application is pending for reference before Collector for more than 30 days, therefore, Authority ought to have acted in accordance with proviso of Section 64 of the Act of 2013.

Proviso of Section Aarti Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76545159/
1 64 of the Act of 2013 is reproduced as under:-
"Provided that the Collector shall, within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt of application, make a reference to the appropriate Authority:
Provided further that where the Collector fails to make such reference within the period so specified, the applicant may apply to the Authority, as the case may be,
requesting it to direct the Collector to make the reference to it within a period of thirty days."
5.

entities.text: Section Aarti Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: In view of same, order dated 29.5.2024 contained in Annexure P/6 is set aside.
Matter is remanded back to Authority for calling reference from Collector within a period of 30 days.
6. Writ Petition is disposed off.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
